relevance_note: A narrative review of retinal vasculitis that mentions TNFAIP3 only at group level ("Patients present early in life with oral ulcers, pathergy, dermal abscesses, chorioretinal scarring, and macular fibrosis secondary to retinal vasculitis."), with no identifiable individual.
method_note: Read the full paper by hand; no script transcribed any table. The only TNFAIP3/A20 content is one passage in 'New insights into pathogenesis' summarising ref 12 at group level, plus mentions in the abstract and Key Points; no individual with a TNFAIP3 variant or HA20 diagnosis is described, so the individual-level tables are empty. The single patient described in detail (Figure 1, a 25 year-old Saudi male with Behçet's disease) has no TNFAIP3 variant or HA20 diagnosis stated and is out of scope. n_patients_reported and cohort_size_as_stated are null: the review has no study cohort of its own (the 207-patient series and other cohorts cited are earlier studies, not this paper's cohort). cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null because the paper reports no patients of its own beyond the Figure 1 illustration. No contradictions found.

study_type.span: This report seeks to establish a common understanding of the term, retinal vasculitis, and to review recent papers on this diagnosis.
